scope: Independent source/template/protocol review and synthetic scalar/process-mock tests only; no CUDA, official numeric-array reads, checkpoint deserialization, remote command, actual release or inference by reviewer.

resolved_findings.finding: A process reaped after its outer limit could previously pass because only live processes were checked.
resolved_findings.resolution: Normal reaping first preserves the raw receipt, then requires its measured elapsed time within the declared outer limit; delayed-exit fixture blocks later waves.

resolved_findings.finding: Last source check preceded potentially long stopped-artifact hashing.
resolved_findings.resolution: All launch bindings are reverified after artifact inventories; late mutation retains prior failure and publishes failed_or_incomplete_timing_collection, which the worksheet rejects.

reviewed: Default is inert; actual invocation requires exact root source/protocol/data/child-release/interpreter/checkpoint bindings, fresh host identity, output path, two distinct UUIDs, fixed schedule, no scientific/test/overlap permission.

Complete six-cell capacity summary and root stopped receipt precede seed0 checkpoint selection. The generator binds original100-record valid source and all fixed native/metric/graph/auxiliary sibling hashes.

Three fixed mode waves each launch base0/GPU0 and mix0/GPU1 once; all children are reaped before the next wave. Ancestor exclusion is confined to actual supervisor ancestors, preserving sibling duplicate detection.

Child monotonic lifetime starts before Popen and ends after wait4 reaping. Raw elapsed/CPU/RSS/command/PID/start identity/signals remain in receipt; whole-child limit and absolute cutoff are enforced. Root6300second watchdog includes preflight and publication; child limits are3600/3900 full and600/900 diagnostics.

Spawn registers ownership before validating process identity. Pinned stop_owned checks live PID/parent/start/argv before group signals. Bounded cleanup suppresses repeat SIGINT/TERM, escalates0/5/10 seconds, retains unreaped identities/lock and never automatically retries.

Guard-complete exit0 preserves adverse full-H outcomes and permits predeclared diagnostic waves; nonzero, timeout, implementation/input failure or contamination blocks later waves. All six identities remain with explicit missing entries.

Final file inventory is created only after reaping; late source/artifact inventory failures cannot produce an admissible completed collection. Complete collection is not a claim that every full-H timing outcome succeeded; worksheet independently checks each full-H/diagnostic row.

Generator performs scalar/byte checks only. Root-approved spec enables exact valid admission and six child releases; active parent is published only after unchanged reviewed preflight passes. Fresh separate directories and inert templates prevent silent overwrites; venv path is retained for execution while its resolved executable is hashed.
limits: Root must verify actual stopped/reaped capacity processes and idle physical devices, issue the new factual stopped receipt/spec, inspect generated contracts, and enforce the external6300second watchdog plus30second grace.
The evaluator inner limit is an inference-call alarm; it does not replace the independent whole-child/supervisor watchdogs.
Neither reviewed source nor synthetic tests establish actual full-H execution success, a scientific endpoint, checkpoint promotion or reserved-test permission.
